description.text: Basic Energy cards in the Sword & Shield design, with a ©2020 line and no number or set symbol, in nine types. Sword & Shield booster packs carried the plain cards of eight types; Fairy Energy, whose type the Sword & Shield Series dropped, came only in the Basic Energy packs of Elite Trainer Boxes. Holo copies came in Champion's Path booster packs.
